No speech recognition service on this phone

Recognition needs the internet or a downloaded language pack
This language is not available for recognition on this phone
Recognition is busy. Try again in a moment
Offline recognition for your language is unavailable — listening in English
No internet and no offline language pack. Download one in Black Glass settings (long press on the home screen)
Offline recognition for your language is unavailable — listening in another downloaded language
If the wallpaper changes, Black Glass makes it black again. The previous wallpaper is not kept.
Could not change the wallpaper on this phone
Could not restore the black wallpaper, automatic mode turned off
Monochrome icons on a raised background in search results

The colour of the notification shade and other apps is set by the system. Turn on dark mode (choose the darkest level if offered). On Android 12+ the shade palette follows the wallpaper colour, so a black wallpaper makes it more neutral.
Offline recognition needs a downloaded language pack. Without it, voice search works only online.
Download requested. The system will show its progress
Could not start the offline voice model. Try importing it again

Already downloaded the models (for example, for the keyboard)? Choose the files — you can select all three at once; the language is detected automatically. Otherwise download them in the browser and open the file with Black Glass. Models work without internet and only while you are speaking.
Only when there is no internet
This file is not a Black Glass voice model
No browser to download the model
Black Glass did not get access to this file. Use “Share → Black Glass” or choose the file below
Could not tell the language of this model (Ukrainian, Polish or English expected)
Not enough free space to install the model
Could not install the model. Try again
Tap a profile to make it active. On the home screen swipe left or right to switch, or say “mode work”.
Applied when you switch to this profile (swipe, tile, voice). “Do not disturb” uses your system exceptions (calls, alarms).
The last profile cannot be deleted
Tip for an older battery: turn on charge protection (charge limit around 80%) in the system battery settings — it slows down battery wear the most.
Permission not granted — this source stays off
Android blocks SMS access for apps not installed from Play. In the Black Glass app info that opens now, tap ⋮ → “Allow restricted settings”, then turn SMS on again.
Black wallpaper, grey icons, dark theme
Settings, contacts, calls, calendar, SMS, notifications, media
A minimal offline launcher: no internet permission, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on this phone.
Your own names for apps: long-press an app in the search results.
Background restriction is set per app for the whole phone (Android does not allow it per profile). Tap an app to open its battery settings and choose “Restricted”.
Apps on the home screen: long-press an icon and drag it to any place — top, centre, a corner. If another app is there, they swap. Each profile has its own layout.
How to turn on SMS search

Android 15 and newer (and some Android 13–14 phones), when Black Glass is not installed from Play: Android blocks SMS access until you allow it. 1) Try to turn on “SMS” above once. 2) Open the Black Glass app info (button below). 3) Tap ⋮ in the top right → “Allow restricted settings” and confirm with your PIN or fingerprint. 4) Come back and turn on “SMS” again.
Android 14 and older: just turn on “SMS” above and allow access when asked.
Swipe left or right on the home screen
Profile name on the home screen
A small label at the top; tap it to switch. Off — no label
Last Black Glass crash. Stored only on this phone — copy it and paste into the chat with the developer.
A light vibration on taps and long presses everywhere in Black Glass
No app on this phone can do that
Allow access to contacts to call or text by name
Without the phone permission Black Glass only opens the number in your dialer
Say it after tapping the microphone. Everything is recognised on the phone; messages are always sent by you.
“Call [name]” — opens the number in your dialer
After a 3-second countdown you can cancel. Needs the phone permission
Alarm, flashlight, music, calls… Turn each on or off
Allow Black Glass to “Modify system settings” to change brightness
“Write in [messenger] to [name] saying…” — you press send
“Add event tomorrow at 3 dentist” — saved right away
Time, calculator results, “Opening YouTube”, “Several options — choose on screen”, mode switches
Choose Black Glass as the default digital assistant app — then a long press of the power button (or the assistant gesture) opens search and starts listening.
Text copied — paste it into the chat
Hello! This is how answers will sound.
To speak without the internet, choose an engine with voices stored on the phone, or download offline voices in the speech settings.
A phrase by voice or text → steps in order. A command can have a condition (“Only if” headphones are connected) and can run by itself on an event — then the phrase is optional.

Anything Black Glass understands by voice: “open Maps”, “mode Road”, “previous mode”, “flashlight on”, “brightness 30”, “louder”, “play music”, “play music on Symfonium”, “open subscriptions in YouTube”, “pause”, “timer 10 minutes”, “alarm 7:30”, “route to work”, “call Oleg”, “send sms to Oleg saying I am late”, “write on Telegram to Oleg saying …”, “event meeting tomorrow at 10”, “what time is it”, “say …”, “wait 5 minutes”, “home screen”. Tip: “From search” shows what a step will do.
In empty search: apps you usually open at this time and recent ones. Counted only on the phone
Up to 5 lines above the search field. Long press removes one
These apps stay on the phone and on the home screen, they just don’t appear in Black Glass search.
Hide the clock, network and battery while the home screen is idle. Swipe down from the top edge to see them
Date, next alarm, nearest event and battery at the top of the home screen
A line in empty search that opens all apps A–Z
“%1$s”: silent mode and Do not disturb need access — open the profile settings and allow it
“%1$s”: Android did not allow changing the sound mode
“No sound” and “Do not disturb” need Do not disturb access. In the list that opens, find Black Glass and turn it on — leave other apps as they are. Normal and vibrate work without it.

“Only profile apps” also applies to suggestions, All apps, voice “open”, “open the last one” and command steps. What else is found (contacts, settings…) is chosen in “Global search” below. Recent searches are kept per profile.
Contacts, messages, calendar, settings and app shortcuts in this profile. The calculator and profiles always stay
Work, home, rest: apps, sound, Do not disturb, search
Your phrase → several commands in a row
Others are put aside, not lost — they come back when you switch the profile. Calls, alarms and music always show

Needs notification access for Black Glass only. On the page that opens, turn on Black Glass — do not change other apps. Black Glass sees notifications only to put them aside and sends nothing anywhere.
✓ Notification access granted — the filter works in this profile
Only what the profile has an app for: Phone → contacts with call, Messages → message button and SMS, Calendar → events, Settings → settings. The calculator and profiles always stay.
At a glance, profile name and the fully black screen are set separately in each profile.
App suggestions, recent searches and the “All apps” button are set separately in each profile.
Double tap on an empty spot of the home screen — next profile (works even without the profile name and swipe).

Profiles with their apps, layout, sound, screen and search, your app names, “My commands”, hidden apps, own icons, appearance and voice actions — in one file. Search history is not saved. Apps missing on the phone are remembered and appear in their places once you install them.
Current Black Glass settings will be replaced with the ones from the file.
Could not read or save the file
Restored: profiles %1$d. Apps not installed yet: %2$d — they will appear in their places once installed
The date is always shown. The glance itself is turned on in each profile, where you can also choose what it shows.
Black Glass remembers which apps you open and what you searched for — only on this phone, with automatic limits.
Launch history, learned searches and recent searches in all profiles will be deleted. Settings stay.
Android blocks call history for apps not from Play Store. In the Black Glass settings that open now, tap ⋮ → “Allow restricted settings”, then turn on Recent calls again.
Turn on notification access for Black Glass — then notification texts can be found in search.

Sources are searched only while you type and only with your permission. Notification texts are kept in memory only (never written to storage or sent anywhere): what you swiped away is found until Black Glass restarts. SMS: Google Messages (RCS) chats are not available to other apps — only regular SMS are found.
No steps yet — add the first one.

A “My command” runs by itself when something happens. Music, volume, flashlight, brightness, mode and timer run right away; Android lets an app open only with a tap on the notification — or right away with the permission below.
Charger and wired headphones work while Black Glass is running (as the launcher — almost always).
✓ “Display over other apps” is allowed — apps open without a tap.
Without it an app opens with a tap on the notification. “Display over other apps” lets Android open it right away.
Double tap, the tile, the profile name and swipes cycle only through such profiles; the rest — from settings, search or voice
Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth and mobile data: Android lets only you switch them — the step opens a small panel with the switch, one tap.
Black Glass asks for an access only when you turn on the feature that needs it. Here you see everything at once; tap to change it in Android settings.
Black Glass as the home screen; needed for shortcuts and private space
Profile notification filter and notification text search
Silent mode and Do Not Disturb in profiles
Brightness by voice, command or automation
Automations open apps without a tap (optional)
Contacts in search, calls and messages by voice
Events in search and new events by voice
Automations when headphones or a car connect
Off — the profile’s icons are hidden, but its apps still define search, the notification filter and global search
Off — as in Settings → Home screen
The command\'s conditions are not met
Moved to trash — it can be restored for 30 days
Calls, alarm, flashlight, music… — in three groups
“route to …”, “event tomorrow at 3”, “what time is it”
To save: a phrase or an event, and at least one step
Another command already has this phrase without a condition — only one of them will run. Add “Only if” or change the phrase.
A profile has this name — your command will run instead of switching to it by this phrase.
An app is called “%1$s” — by voice your command will run; search shows both.
This is also a built-in command — your command will run instead.
No internet — the offline model is listening now, say it again
System state: battery, RAM, storage, heat, network
This profile’s screen shows the live system monitoring (double tap does not switch profiles here)

Open it with the “monitoring” command (voice or text) from any profile, or turn it on as a profile’s screen in Profiles. Data refreshes only while it is on screen. Double tap does not switch profiles on the monitoring screen — use the tile, voice or a swipe.
✓ Granted — screen time, data today and top apps are shown.
Screen time today, mobile data today and top apps need “Usage access”, granted once in Android settings.
Screen time, data today and top apps on the monitoring screen
Screen time and data — with “Usage access” (Settings → Monitoring)
Headroom — how much more the phone can heat up before Android starts slowing the processor to cool it down. 100% — cool, 0% — slowing down.
Past midnight works too: from 22:00 until 06:00. Without time — only the chosen days.
When the condition is NOT met (e.g. headphones not connected)
The step runs only if all of these are met; otherwise it is skipped and the next steps go on.
Speak. Before doing anything the phone will ask you to unlock it. Tap anywhere to cancel.
The message opens ready — you press Send.
Steps after the pause run later. Long pauses use the system alarm — nothing runs in the background; in deep sleep Android may shift it by a few minutes.
e.g. “route to work”, “timer 5 minutes”, an app name
Opposite event and opposite steps (music → pause, mode → previous mode, app → home screen). Check and save it.
Spoken with the voice from the voice settings; with headphones connected — into the headphones. Add the step condition “headphones connected” so it does not speak out loud.
Runs on its own at this time (even with the screen off). Add conditions like “current mode Work” so it only speaks when needed.
Leaving a mode where music is playing pauses it and hides the app (it stays in the background — Android does not allow closing other apps); coming back to that mode resumes the music.
On every full hour says the time — only when headphones are connected and you are not on a call.
New messages from messengers and SMS: “Message from Oleg: …” — only with headphones connected, not during a call; messages hidden by the profile filter are not read.
Needs “Notification access” — without it Android does not pass notifications to Black Glass.
Step %1$d: app or command “%2$s” not found — the step will do nothing.
The conditions contradict each other (or the event) — the command will never run.
Step %1$d: its conditions contradict the command\'s — it will always be skipped.
Step %1$d: a pause at the end does nothing — add steps after it or remove it.
Step %1$d opens a screen: when the command starts on its own, it will wait for a tap on the notification (or allow “Display over other apps” below).
Another command “%1$s” starts from the same event — both will run one after another.
Several options — choose on the screen
Created from the previous command: opposite event and opposite steps. Check it and press “Save” — then it appears in the list.
The reverse command already exists — you will find it in the list.
%1$s is not a music or video app
That is not a music or video app — name a player (e.g. “play music on Symfonium”)
%1$s can\'t do “%2$s” — here is what it can
An event is a moment that starts the command by itself (e.g. headphones just connected, at 7:30, mode turned on).
A condition is a state checked at the moment the command starts (e.g. headphones are connected now). It starts nothing by itself.
Say “%1$s” the way you pronounce it
Tick one or more modes — the command works in any of them.

Command steps (also automatic ones, e.g. on headphones) open or start music only in apps that are in the current mode (on its home screen); others are skipped. What you say or type yourself still works. In a mode with “Only profile apps” search this always applies.
That app is not in this mode — step skipped
Focus timer: mode not changed until it ends
Wait a moment — maybe it is not that urgent. The button unlocks when the countdown ends.
Until the timer ends the mode does not change and Black Glass settings stay closed. Calls work as usual.

Only the countdown on screen, pinned by Android: Recents, the shade and other apps are blocked. Android will ask “Pin app?” — tap “Pin”. To unpin — the system gesture (with a PIN if enabled in phone settings → App pinning)
Until the end: no switching modes, Black Glass settings closed, automations do not change the mode. Then it returns to the previous mode by itself.
🔒 Screen pinned until the timer ends
Not pinned. The timer still runs — tap “Pin” to block Recents and the shade.

Switches to the chosen mode for 15 minutes to 2 hours: until the end the mode does not change and Black Glass settings are closed; ending early takes holding a button and a minute of waiting. Then it returns to the previous mode by itself (no background work — one alarm).

With a countdown, any switch away from this mode in Black Glass (swipe, double tap, label, tile, voice, search) and opening Black Glass settings work only when the countdown ends. Automations you set up in advance switch without it.
Step 1 of 2 — press and hold the button below for 3 seconds.
Step 2 of 2 — wait one minute. If the urge passes, just tap “Stay”.
Done — now you can end the timer.
A pencil-drawn cat wanders around while the timer runs
Take a breath. Do you really want to open it now?
Today’s limit is used up: %1$d of %2$d min
Pause before apps, daily limits, weekly summary

Before these apps open from Black Glass (home screen, search, voice) there is a short pause with a countdown — the impulse often passes. Tap an app to set a daily limit. Apps opened from notifications or Recents open as usual — Android does not let launchers stop that.
Time today and limits need “Usage access” — a separate Android permission (not the same as notification access). Granted once with the button below.
Screen time for the last 7 days needs “Usage access” — granted once in Android settings. Counted only on this phone.
Time in apps from Android’s records; Black Glass itself is not counted. Android keeps records for about a week.
When the limit is used up, the pause gets longer (30 s) and says so. The app still opens — it is a reminder, not a lock.
A small dot on an app icon when it has notifications in the shade
At the bottom of the home screen: the song, previous / pause / next / stop; tap the title for a full-screen player. Hides a minute after pausing, “Stop” hides it at once
The timer keeps running: switching modes and settings stay locked. Back to it — the label on the home screen → “Open the timer”.
Three small games drawn like the cat
Off — games are hidden here and in search
A game you leave is saved and continues from the same place. Records stay only on this phone. Games do not open during the focus timer.

Fast. Your ship at the bottom, a swarm of aliens above; some dive and drop bombs (never too many at once). A level is several waves. Shot-down aliens sometimes drop a capsule: two guns, a fan of three, rapid fire, a shield, an extra life. Every 4th level is a bonus stage — they fly past without shooting (100 each, all of them +10000). Three lives, one more every 5000 points.

Calm. Pieces of four squares fall into a glass; a full row disappears — points for rows (100–800 × level), a bonus for a streak of rows in a row and a big one for a completely clean glass. A new level every 100 rows (classic speed table, faster up to level 29, then the top speed stays). Pause any time.

Minimal: a line and a dot. A calm start; swipe to turn; before a wall the head pauses for a moment so you can still turn. Three lives; every 20 dots — a new level, a bit faster, and every two levels new obstacles. Bonuses: gold (points), snail (slower), scissors (shorter tail), heart (a life).
Hold your finger and move it left and right — the ship follows and shoots by itself.
Drag left and right — the piece follows your finger; drag down — falls faster; long press or a quick swipe down — drops at once; light tap — rotates.
Swipe in any direction to turn.
Games do not open during the focus timer
Bonus stage — they do not shoot
Minimum, Tempo or Cozy — a ready start, then change anything

A set changes the look, the home screen and search of every mode, voice replies, notification dots, “Now playing”, the cat and which game is in the menu. Your apps, modes, commands and history stay. After that, everything can be changed by hand.
As little as possible: a fully black screen without a label or glance, no suggestions or recent searches, no voice replies, dots or “Now playing”. Game: Snake.

Switch and launch quickly: swipe between modes, glance with clock and events, suggestions, recent searches and All apps, the status bar visible, voice replies, dots and “Now playing”. Game: Star Patrol.
Unhurried and calm: a big clock and glance, gentle suggestions without recent searches, no accidental swipes, voice replies, “Now playing” and the cat on the focus timer. Game: Blocks.
The look and behaviour change; your apps, modes and commands stay. Then you can change anything.
Choose a ready set to start with — everything can be changed later in Settings → Settings sets.
Set applied — change anything in Settings
Settings, menus and windows look hand-written in white pencil on a black sheet: a hand-written font, pencil frames, switched-off items crossed out, names instead of icons

Tap a line to turn it on or off: crossed out means off. Home screen and search are hand-written too: names instead of app icons. Games, the focus timer and the remaining icons are drawn in pencil too. Font: Caveat (SIL Open Font License), built in — no internet.
Ask the phone for the screen’s highest refresh rate (120 Hz on OnePlus 13): scrolling, games, the cat and animations look smoother. Uses a little more battery; off — the phone decides itself
The glance is switched on separately in each mode; here — for the current one
Attempts — how many times during the timer you tried to leave the mode or open the settings.
